backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic; all functionality is client-side.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: Leaflet.js map integration with OpenStreetMap tiles, browser Geolocation API tracking with continuous position updates, and a status overlay UI component with live coordinates display.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing their roles in the location tracking application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes, plus base styles for body and border elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads Leaflet.js 1.9.4 CSS and JS from CDN with integrity hashes and mounts the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component that initializes Leaflet map, integrates geolocation tracking via custom hook, manages map markers, and renders StatusOverlay and Footer components.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution, and a caffeine.ai link with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/StatusOverlay.ts: Status overlay UI component that displays tracking status with icons, color-coded states, and live latitude/longitude coordinates formatted to 5 decimal places.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook for managing ICP backend actor instances with authentication via Internet Identity, including query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Custom React hook that manages browser Geolocation API with continuous position watching (watchPosition), error handling, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality and identity management with AuthClient integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file with no backend queries since all location tracking is handled client-side.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors (using OKLCH color space), base styles for full-height layout, and Leaflet map container styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient for data fetching, InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining custom color tokens mapped to CSS variables (OKLCH format), border radius utilities, accordion animations, and includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a live location tracker app built with Leaflet.js, OpenStreetMap tiles, and browser Geolocation API, with four implemented features for map rendering, GPS tracking, status overlay, and minimal design aesthetic.
